spec2def(shimgvw.dll shimgvw.spec)

file(GLOB_RECURSE shimgvw_rc_deps res/*.*)

# shimgvw.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/shimgvw-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(shimgvw_shims OBJECT anime.c loader.cpp shimgvw.c comsup.c util.c)
target_link_libraries(shimgvw_shims PRIVATE wine libadvapi32 libcomctl32 libuser32 libgdi32 libshell32 libole32 libgdiplus libcomdlg32 libshlwapi libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(shimgvw_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(shimgvw shimgvw-cargo shimgvw.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS shimgvw_shims psdk)
